name: rust-libbin-defect
body:
A default lib+bin Cargo package's two crate roots collide on one module FQN. rust.apg-rustfrontend.package_prefix_map (src/rustlib/src/main.rs:972–995) assigns the cargo package name as a module prefix exactly when the package maps to one local crate target; a multi-target package keeps the fallback. rust.apg-rustfrontend.crate_prefix (:999–1017) falls back to krate.display_name(). For a default lib+bin package ([package] name = "apg" → lib target apg, bin target apg) both crates return the same display name, so both crate roots render the module FQN rust.apg. rust.apg.ingest.insert_node (src/ingest.rs:466–489) reaches the duplicate project node FQN arm and panics (line 486) on the duplicate non-planned node.

Resolution: each crate of a multi-target package carries a distinct, stable module prefix, subject to requirements.constraint.rust-crate-fqn-distinct and requirements.constraint.rust-crate-fqn-stability; the disambiguation scheme is an implementation choice, left to the plan.
